HexKagune 1.3.0 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 54). Testing build: nothing of it has been tried in game yet.

- The Library: a new structure in the world, with Eto living on its ground floor (`/locate structure hexkagune:library`, `/summon hexkagune:eto`).
- Eto: talk, chat once a day, give her books and flowers; her regard is one bond shared by ghouls and humans.
- Eto's three lessons open the Speed Kick, the soaring flips and Witness This for ghouls (the old quests still work too).
- At full regard: three errands (books, ten kills at night, a flower), then ask her out.
- Dating: kiss (tap shift for a peck, hold it and she blushes, ignore her and she gets mad and ignores you), hug, and "Make me like you".
- Her kakugan opens in her right eye at night and when she fights; she blinks, shuts her eyes for kisses and blushes.
- She fights hostiles that come close and anyone who hits her: Speed Blitz, Big Punch, Speed Kick, flips; she heals after.
- One eyed in the kakugan screen is now Eto's gift only (anyone already one eyed keeps it).
